show.description: A gripping drama that uncovers the ruthless world of power, betrayal, and ambition. As secrets unravel and loyalties are tested, relationships shatter and truths come at a cost. With intense confrontations and unexpected twists, the story dives deep into how far people can go to protect their status and control.
